column1: # Coupled-math issue-relative stall matrix -- recovered by differential analysis
# of CUDA 13.1 ptxas-emitted SASS (no vendor table bytes; this is our own result).
# A coupled (fixed-latency) producer resolves a RAW with a usched stall whose
# magnitude is set by the producer pipe and the consumer pipe.  ptxas's OCG
# scheduler derives it from the producer's result band and the consumer's
# operand-collect timing; we recover the resulting issue-relative magnitudes here
# by decoding the producer's emitted usched on immediate (gap=1) dependent pairs
# across sm_75..sm_120.
# Columns: family  prod_pipe  cons_pipe  stall
#   family    : latency-descriptor family (sm7x = sm_60/70/72/75;
#   prod_pipe : INT IMUL FMA FP16 CC CVT UNIFORM  (* = any)
#   cons_pipe : INT IMUL FMA FP16 CC CVT AGU SFU CVTI UNIFORM  (* = any)
#               AGU  = memory address/data collect; SFU = MUFU transcendental
#               input; CVTI = decoupled float<->int conversion input (I2F/F2I/F2F)
#   stall     : usched cycles the consumer owes the producer
# Resolution (sass_latency_tables.coupled_stall): exact (fam,pp,cp) first, then
# producer-specific (fam,pp,*) [outranks], then consumer-specific (fam,*,cp),
# trying the arch family before the family-`*` row; then structural anchors.
# -- CC / predicate-guard producer (control band): the predicated consumer cannot
#    proceed without the flag, so it is emitted in full.  sm7x = 12, sm8x+ = 13.
sm7x
# -- same-pipe coupled math -> same-pipe coupled math: forwarding stall 4.
#   packed FP16x2 same-pipe diverges by arch: 6 (sm7x), 4 (sm8x/sm10x baseline);
#   sm_90/sm_90a's HFMA2.MMA lowering costs 10 -- handled as the sm8x default 4
#   here (rare in scalar code; the safe fixpoint never under-stalls it).
sm7x
# -- cross-pipe coupled math (a different math family): +1 inter-pipe penalty.
#   int -> coupled int->float conversion (I2FP): 4 on sm_86..sm_100, 5 on the
#   newest sm_10x (sm_120); I2FP is absent on sm7x (conversion is decoupled I2F).
sm10x
# -- coupled producer -> memory address/data (AGU): pre-issue collect slot.
#    sm8x+/sm10x = 5; Turing-class sm7x widens it to 8.
sm7x
# -- coupled producer -> MUFU transcendental input (SFU): full result band (6) on
#    sm7x, forwarded at 4 on sm8x+.
sm7x
# -- coupled producer -> decoupled float<->int conversion input (CVTI: I2F/F2I/
#    F2F): the coupled feeder pays the full result band (6) before the decoupled
#    conversion issues, on every arch.
